# Manual source versions and releases

Run **Bump version** on a branch with the required `patch`, `minor`, or
`major` choice (default `patch`). It validates the immutable selected commit,
creates one source-only direct child as `github-actions[bot]`, and pushes only
that branch. It never builds, tags, releases, or starts Build. Remote reads and
the committed executable pre-push guard reject stale advertisements, including
rewinds, deletions, and same-result races.

Run **Build** independently using Actions' built-in branch/tag selector.
There are no custom inputs. Every job checks out `github.sha`; canonical
`X.Y.Z` comes from source, not a typed tag. Build is not restricted to the default
branch. Publication uses one repository-wide concurrency group with cancellation
disabled; this does not promise FIFO ordering.

## Source authority

At intake `9e6c5ec62edc959784e084c9ad938dfe3614f37b`, API canonical identity
`miyako/4d-plugin-pngcrush`, API default `master`, symbolic `origin/HEAD`,
and advertised HEAD/default agreed. The complete rename-follow Bump history
starts at `53f6615cc9ffb11d6e84176401d9e557a3cbd20c`. Its explicit header
coordinates `MARKETING_VERSION`, `CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION`, and the two plist
version keys, despite the buggy body updating only the selected project key.
`1467bf49c0d787871968eb305452a6caaed9d559` reaffirmed coordinated fields and
added missing version assignments across all six configurations.

There is **no intake increment**. Only six stale `CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION`
tokens (`2.0.2`) and the actual copied source English short/info tokens
(`2.0.0`) are aligned to existing marketing/plist authority `2.0.4`.
Development/Deployment/Default identities and all native settings remain intact.
Source `Info.plist` requires its short version; its optional absent build key
remains absent. References are resolved and preserved. Duplicate, cyclic,
unresolved, missing, drifting, or noncanonical fields fail before any writes.
Edits preserve encodings, BOMs, individual line endings (including source English
CR endings), file modes, and unrelated bytes.

The committed prebuilt bundle, including stale UTF-16 destination localization,
is not source authority and is unchanged by Bump or migration. Manifest and 4D
counters, native projects, frameworks, dependencies, and packaged siblings are
otherwise preserved.

## Native scope and retained outputs

Original topology remains: Ubuntu version preflight, Windows x64 Release
MSBuild, then macOS Default universal. The Windows CMD invocation retains
v143 and Windows SDK 10.0 overrides; exact vcxproj output is
`test/plugins/Pngcrush.bundle/contents/windows64/Pngcrush.4DX`, resolved one
case-insensitive component at a time, never by recursive first match.
There is no new runtime-DLL policy. Inherited scoped `core.autocrlf=false`
applies before every Build checkout without changing global Git configuration.
Only actual Windows regular worktree executable bits may differ; raw bytes,
all index modes/blobs, nonregular types, and reparse points remain guarded.

macOS retains Default target/configuration, deployment override 11.0,
`test/Plugins` output, required exact `arm64` and `x86_64` slices (extras allowed),
frameworks, the 57-file `lib/pngcrush-1.8.11` resource folder, manifest/constants,
English localization, and downloaded Windows64 merge. The unchanged project
custom signing/altool shell phase is explicitly **Deployment-only**, inactive
under Default; no opt-out flag or unrelated native-phase edit is introduced.
The original workflow did not inspect runtime dylib architectures; no new
restriction is imposed.

Cleanup prevalidates every target before deleting exact generated leaves and
proven intermediates. It never deletes whole bundles, lowercase plugin roots,
Default siblings, or unlisted resources. Initial preflight rejects all dirt,
including ignored outputs. Final validation retains fresh generated bytes while
independently checking immutable HEAD, the entire index, hidden flags, raw
nongenerated bytes, and ignored/untracked paths. Only exact generated leaves
and known intermediate families are exempt from worktree equality.
XCBuildData allows only `build.db`, `build.db-wal`, `build.db-shm`, and
32-lowercase-hex `.xcbuilddata` descendants; it is not recursively cleaned.

Built XML/binary plist and compiled/text localization are revalidated after native
operations. All 57 resource files and manifest/constants must exactly match their
individual source files; downloaded and merged Windows64 bytes must agree.
Every packaged generated leaf, including executable, signature, and each copied
resource, must remain nonempty, regular, and nonsymlink before any final API call.
Unsigned validation is separate from signed-final validation. Other packaged
content, including Windows32, QuickLook, LICENSE, and old `Contents/CodeResources`,
remains protected.

Developer ID signing, strict verification, two notary submissions, and DMG-only
stapling remain required. Notarization requires exit zero **and** strict JSON
`status: Accepted`. Certificate/notary secrets are used only by the manual hosted
workflow.

## Create-only publication and recovery

Publication requires explicit nonempty `GH_TOKEN`, immutable `GITHUB_SHA`,
and the exact API-canonical repository identity above. Authenticated release
pages, including drafts, are read until an empty page. Strict JSON/schema checks
fail closed. Exact API and Git tag absence is checked before native work and
again after signing, notarization, and stapling.

The publisher separately creates `vX.Y.Z` at the selected SHA, verifies it through
API and Git, creates a new public release with a new positive ID, then uploads
exactly `Pngcrush-X.Y.Z.zip` and `Pngcrush-X.Y.Z.dmg` to that ID. The original empty
body and disabled generated-notes policy are preserved. No update, reuse, clobber,
deletion, rollback, retry, or dispatch occurs. A same-SHA creation race still fails.

On failure, manually inspect the reported retained tag, release ID, and confirmed
or possibly uploaded assets. Partial state is deliberately retained. Do not
blindly rerun an occupied version: an operator must decide how to recover, or
bump source and manually build a new version.

## Offline regression suite

Run `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` and
`actionlint .github/workflows/*.yml`. Python needs PyYAML; Windows-phase tests need
PowerShell and fail rather than skip if it is absent. Native and credential
commands run only behind closed-PATH doubles; Git races use local bare repositories.
The original CMD build is asserted verbatim, not replaced with a CMD adapter.
The suite does not execute or prove hosted native toolchains or Apple services.

Helpers/tests adapt immutable reviewed RTF2TEXT
`4a8c89677515cd5c71c162e0b296e63bee374cdd`, shell-execute-v2
`ee33f21111d9a042101ccc11d68672a7a0067e9c`, stomp
`ab9f5e51dba5b8b6ec1a1b70e191082fcb73fb41`, and libarchive
`9547d09522fc422ddd754fb088165b3d1d1d3073` guards, without their unrelated
dependency exceptions. The complete 16-reference raw-blob/full-reading evidence
and final/genuine-child proof logs are retained in the migration session artifacts.
